parsed.answer: For the next Larch outage, Mara should use REPLAY-0-632, the recovery procedure tested on August 8 that restored the missing updates. The delivery-mode change was attributed to the GATE-0-519 outages; Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286 on August 15. The August 8 meeting itself approved no delivery-mode change.

citations.quote: Mara reported that BATCH-0-741 lost updates during GATE-0-519 outages. The team tested REPLAY-0-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.

Mara approved switching Larch from BATCH-0-741 to STREAM-0-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision. The cause was the GATE-0-519 outages recorded on August 8; keep the successful recovery procedure from that incident.
